name: Sara Britain
source:
38th Queen of Aeris Empire.

She inherited the throne, but chooses to remain in the front-line to command her fleets. Nobility and honesty she always values during her acts on the duties as a queen. 

[Edited from the [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Sarah_Britten]AliceWikiSoft's website[/url].]
